question: Which of the following Indian cities was the host of the ICC Men's World Cup final cricket match in 2023?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Ahmedabad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **ICC Men's World Cup 2023 final** cricket match was hosted in **Ahmedabad**, Gujarat, India.
 
• The match took place at the **Narendra Modi Stadium**, which is the **largest cricket stadium in the world** in terms of seating capacity, accommodating over **132,000 spectators**.
 
• The stadium is located in the **Motera area of Ahmedabad** and is known for its state-of-the-art facilities and infrastructure.
 
• The venue has hosted several **high-profile cricket matches**, including Test matches, ODIs, and T20 internationals, making it a preferred location for global cricketing events.
 
• The **Narendra Modi Stadium** was renovated and inaugurated in **2020**, replacing the old Sardar Patel Stadium.
 
• Ahmedabad is a major hub for cricket in India and has a rich history of hosting **domestic and international cricket tournaments**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mumbai**__

 __
 
• **Mumbai** is home to the iconic **Wankhede Stadium**, which hosted the **ICC Men's World Cup 2011 final**, where India won the championship.
 
• Wankhede Stadium is located near the **Marine Drive area** and has a seating capacity of approximately **33,000 spectators**.
 
 
 
• **Chennai**__
 __
 
• **Chennai** houses the **MA Chidambaram Stadium**, one of the oldest cricket stadiums in India, known for its passionate crowd and historical significance.
 
• The stadium is located in the **Chepauk area** and has hosted several historic cricket matches.
 
 
 
• **New Delhi**__
 
 
• **New Delhi** is home to the **Arun Jaitley Stadium** (formerly known as Feroz Shah Kotla), which has hosted numerous international matches.
 
• The stadium is located in the heart of the city and has a capacity of around **41,820 spectators**.
